articles.summary: Entravision Communications Corporation (NYSE: EVC), a media and advertising technology company, today announced financial results for its first quarter ended March 31, 2026. "Net revenue in our Media segment increased 4% in first quarter 2026 compared to first quarter 2025 due to an increase in digital advertising revenue and retransmission fees which were partially offset by lower broadcast advertising revenue and revenue from spectrum usage rights.
